text:
olivia: Quick follow-up from the DR postmortem — I pulled the action items into this thread so we can track ownership/times. Please ack and put an ETA.

mike: Ack. I'll own the multi-region routing policy changes (make failover prefer warm-standby, tighten health-probe thresholds). ETA: propose config by 2026-03-26.

sanjay: I will own backups validation + restore runbook updates. Need a sandbox cluster and temp creds. ETA: initial runbook update by 2026-03-24.

katherine: I'll run the regional game day drill. Proposed date: 2026-04-01 09:00 PT. Need confirmation on scope (routing + restore).

ben: I'll provide the synthetic traffic harness and runbook integration. Sharing script link in a sec.

ben: https://git.redwood.internal/rinfra/game-day-scripts/blob/main/latency-flood.sh :thumbsup:

olivia: Sanjay, Ben — can you pair on restore checkpoints? We had 2 recurring failure patterns: delayed KV cache invalidation and missed BGP withdraws. Need explicit test cases in the runbook for both.

sanjay: Good point. I'll add test steps: 1) simulate cache-stale responses, 2) force route withdraw and verify fallback.

mike: Also adding a configuration guard to prevent routes advertising when health < 80%. I'll draft the PR and tag eng-sre for review.

ops-bot: Created Jira RINF-2026-451: "DR postmortem — routing policy changes" assigned to mike, due 2026-03-26.

ops-bot: Created Jira RINF-2026-452: "Backup validation & restore runbook" assigned to sanjay, due 2026-03-24.

olivia: Action log (brief):
- RINF-2026-451 (mike) routing policy PR draft by 3/26
- RINF-2026-452 (sanjay) restore runbook & test artifacts by 3/24
- RINF-2026-453 (katherine) game day plan & invite by 3/28
- RINF-2026-454 (ben) synthetic traffic integration by 3/30

katherine: I'll own RINF-2026-453, will send calendar invite to eng, infra, and oncall. Please mark if you can't attend.

mike: One ask — can we make routing changes behind a feature flag so we can A/B during the game day?

olivia: Yes, feature-flag + canary rollout. We should also add a fallback to the older routing policy if any restore fails.

ben: Shared initial synthetic script and a small README. I added a runbook hook example: 
```bash
# runbook hook example
./latency-flood.sh --targets eu,us-west --duration 600
# integrate with restore runbook: call restore-check.sh after routing withdraw
```

sanjay: Adding restore-check.sh to the repo. Snippet for health checks: 
```bash
# restore-check.sh
ssh -i /keys/test.pem admin@restore-host 'sudo systemctl start inference'
curl -s http://restore-host/health | jq '.status'
```

olivia: Recurring incident pattern note: last 3 DRs had the same root cause chain — partial BGP withdraws -> client-side sticky sessions -> KV cache mismatches. We need test cases to hit that exact chain during the game day.

katherine: Agreed — game day scope: routing withdraw simulation, restore runbook exec, and end-to-end correctness check (read/write to model store).

mike: I'll open the routing PR and add a canary rollout. Tagging @katherine for the game-day rollout window.

deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline for branch mike/dr-routing-pr created (build 342).

olivia: Cool. Summary of immediate next steps: mike draft PR by 3/26, sanjay runbook update by 3/24, katherine calendar + game day playbook by 3/28, ben integrate traffic by 3/30.

ben: Acked. I'll also add metrics dashboards for the game day: routing-errors, restore-latency, kv-cache-hit.

sanjay: Requesting sandbox creds — @olivia can you escalate?

olivia: On it — will DM infra and post creds here when available.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up standup for DR remediation sync on 2026-03-25 10:00 PT.

katherine: Thanks all — please update your Jira tickets as work progresses. I'll collate a runbook checklist and share it this week. :raised_hands:

olivia: Thanks team. If any blockers pop up, ping #eng-oncall and add an urgent label to the ticket.

mike: ack.
